description: Every GSA schedule labor rate published by one contractor — what this specific company charges the government per hour, across its labor categories, with contract numbers and SINs. Use for "what rates does Booz Allen have on its GSA schedule" or to compare one vendor against the market median. Example: gsa_vendor_rates({ vendor: "DIGNITAS TECHNOLOGIES" })

business_size.description: "S" for small business or "O" for other than small. "small" and "large" also work.

education.description: Minimum education: HS, AA, BA or MA. Plain spellings work too ("bachelors", "high school"). Combine with | for several, e.g. "BA|MA".

max_experience.description: Maximum years of experience required, inclusive.

max_rate.description: Only rates at or below this hourly price, USD.

min_experience.description: Minimum years of experience required, inclusive. Means "this many OR MORE" — mapped to the upstream range filter, because the upstream field of the same name is an exact match.

min_rate.description: Only rates at or above this hourly price, USD.

security_clearance.description: "yes" to only rates requiring a clearance, "no" to exclude them.

vendor.description: Company name or a distinctive fragment of it, e.g. "DIGNITAS" or "Booz Allen". Vendor names are recorded in full legal form on the contract.

worksite.description: Where the work is performed: "contractor" (vendor site) or "customer" (government site).

name: gsa_vendor_rates
title: Gsa Vendor Rates
